cohort: 657 women receiving caseload midwifery care and 1954 matched controls receiving regular midwife-led care in the Netherlands in 2015
finding: Caseload midwifery care in the Netherlands is associated with a lower referral rate to obstetrician-led care and a higher spontaneous vaginal birth rate, with similar perinatal safety compared to regular midwife-led care.
mod_finding: Caseload midwifery care was associated with a higher spontaneous vaginal birth rate, fewer inductions of labor, more homebirths, and less perineal damage compared to regular midwife-led care.
